note: 卖铁相关物品,最近迷上了做饭。译名用「熔铁匠」和 Blacksmith(铁匠)区分开。

messages.raw: §fFor my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!
messages.text: For my wares, you'll have to pay the iron price!
messages.zh: 想要我的货,就得付出铁的代价!

messages.raw: §fClick me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!
messages.text: Click me again to open the Iron Forger Shop!
messages.zh: 再点我一下就能打开熔铁匠商店!

messages.raw: §fI've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.
messages.text: I've recently got into cooking, yesterday I made pasta carbonara, today I'm planning on baking a carrot cake.
messages.zh: 我最近迷上了做饭,昨天做了培根蛋面,今天打算烤个胡萝卜蛋糕。

messages.raw: §fThat's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks, §6%s§f!
messages.text: That's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks, %s!

segments.text: That's quite an excessive amount of carrots, but it'll do! Thanks,
segments.zh: 胡萝卜是有点太多了,不过将就着用吧! 谢啦,

messages.raw: §fWill have to order some food today then.
messages.text: Will have to order some food today then.
